text: @lovstudio/dsh-better-restart 是一款面向 DSH Web 的应用重启插件，在设置栏提供重启入口。浏览器端通过状态路由读取当前正在运行的 agent 对话，并通过重启路由请求主机重启；有对话运行时，确认框显示数量并要求用户勾选确认中断。主机端优先调用可用的 appRestart 服务，否则尝试重新加载根插件树；若两种方式都不可用，会返回错误。操作期间按钮显示加载状态，页面在连接恢复后刷新。插件还向其他浏览器插件提供状态与重启服务。适合需要从 Web 界面重启 DSH 应用的用户；代码中未发现需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart adds a restart button to DSH Web settings. It checks running conversations and asks for acknowledgement before interruption. The host uses appRestart or reloads the plugin tree; the page refreshes after reconnect. No API key or external service is declared.
想从 DSH 网页设置里直接重启整个应用。
Can I check whether agent conversations are running before restarting my DSH web app?
@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart 的「查看活动并确认重启」功能：从设置栏打开确认框后，会轮询运行中的对话并显示数量；存在活动时需要勾选确认，再提交重启请求，随后等待连接恢复并刷新页面。

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart README · dsh-better-restart：Lovstudio's in-place application restart plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web surface. The settings header gains a **Restart app** action that re-boots the whole application in place (reloading the current tab, not opening a new one), with a confirmation dialog that watches running conversations live.

This is a **Lovstudio** plugin, not a DeepSeek-AI package, distributed under the `@lovstudio` scope.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart README · What it does：- **Host half** exposes two `webServer` routes:
  - `POST /better-restart/status` — `{ running, active }` (how many agent loops are mid-turn).
  - `POST /better-restart` — restarts the application, preferring the launcher's `appRestart` service and falling back to a root-include recompose.
- **Client half** (settings-header button):
  - Confirmation dialog that polls agent activity live (1.5s). With conversations running it reports the count and gates the restart behind an explicit acknowledgement; without running conversations the restart passes straight through.
  - In-flight spinner + disabled button while restarting; the current tab reloads on reconnect.
  - A `betterRestartUi` Cordis service exposing the same `status()` and `restart()` operations to other browser plugins.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart README · What it does：The plugin is completely runtime and self-contained: it reaches DSH capabilities through the injected Cordis `ctx` only (`webServer`, `agents`, `appRestart`), and the client page reaches the host through plain fetch to those routes — no Remote assembly, no build-time transforms. It has no package dependencies beyond node builtins.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart README · Install：Prerequisites: Node.js 22.19+ or 24+, pnpm 11 (`corepack enable` or `npm i -g pnpm`) — `dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory.

**From a DeepSeek Harness source checkout (recommended — you get the harness source too):**

```sh
git clone --depth 1 --branch dsh-v0.1.2-rc.1 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness && pnpm install && pnpm run build
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:lovstudio/dsh-better-restart#v0.1.4
pnpm dsh web

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart README · Install：**Without a checkout (npx; compiled harness only):**

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:lovstudio/dsh-better-restart#v0.1.4
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart README · How the restart happens：1. **`appRestart`** — a launcher-provided service that re-boots the process. `dsh` 0.1.2-rc.1 provides none; this is the path a future or embedding launcher takes, and the route answers `204`.
2. **Root-include recompose** — the fallback that makes the button work under plain `dsh web`. The loader's root `cordis:include` entry is disabled and re-enabled, which re-reads the composed `cordis.yml` plus the user patch layers and restarts every plugin under it, the web server included. The node process itself survives, so the terminal that launched `dsh web` keeps owning it. The route answers `202 {"mode":"recompose"}` and only then tears the tree down — the response is held until its socket closes, because a recompose that races the flush reaches the browser as a transport failure rather than an accepted restart.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart README · How the restart happens：An app with neither lever answers `503` with that reason, the settings action shows a copyable failure instead of pretending to restart, and any plugin driving this service — the plugin marketplace, for one — sees the same rejection.

Because the process is reused, a recompose re-reads configuration and loads newly installed plugins, but Node's ESM cache means edited source of an already-loaded module is picked up only through the profile's own HMR watcher.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart README · How the restart happens：`web` is the profile `dsh web` boots. The tag pins a commit whose `lib/` is prebuilt and committed, so nothing is compiled on your machine. Verified on 2026-09-05 against `dsh-v0.1.2-rc.1` in both forms, including the recompose fallback end to end in the browser. Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove @lovstudio/dsh-better-restart`.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart README · How the restart happens：The client half (`dsh.client`) is served to the page automatically by the client module system once the plugin is composed — no rebuild of the web application is needed.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart README · Local development：Keep this checkout outside the DeepSeek Harness repository. Install and build it here, then link the package into an isolated development profile:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run watch

DSH_HOME=/Users/mark/.dsh-lov-dev pnpm --dir /path/to/deepseek-harness dsh plugin --profile web add -w link:/path/to/dsh-better-restart

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart README · Local development：The Host consumes the generated `index.js`, while the browser module system consumes `lib/client.js`. Client-only rebuilds are detected by the Harness Client HMR watcher; Host, manifest, patch, and bundle-membership changes require a profile restart. The package build does not import a Harness tsconfig or workspace source path.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart README · Notes：- Requires `webServer` and `agents` (both from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`); `appRestart` and `loader` are each optional, and the route reports when neither is there.
- Copy lives under `@lovstudio/dsh-better-restart` (zh/en), auto-registered to the `better-restart-ui` locale namespace.
